entries.summary: Cyclomatic complexity measures paths through local control flow; it does not reveal duplicated authorization, lifecycle, or cross-repository meaning by itself.

evidence.note: The analyzer emits function and branch-line evidence only.
Refactor jobs carry related architectural-memory IDs separately from the numeric finding.

entries.decision: Use cyclomatic findings to locate investigation candidates, then consult architectural memory and verification before authorizing a refactor.
entries.next_trigger: Any new aggregate score must expose its factors and prove that it improves refactor selection on gold fixtures.

entries.summary: Inventory completeness, syntax coverage and complexity are separate claims. Unrecognized source never becomes a healthy zero score. Diagnostic/configuration/template literals remain protected from displacement.

evidence.note: Coverage conserves every inventoried source file and protects unscored data before comparison.
Real format cases prove source lines and explicit decisions; unsupported dialects stay unmeasured.
Pinned public stand-ins disclose remaining gaps and finite capacity; they do not prove universal language support or engineering outcomes.

entries.decision: Add validated readers at the shared producer boundary, retain all file accounting, and label analysis upgrades as baselines without Work credit. Never hide unsupported syntax to reach 100 percent.
entries.next_trigger: Any new dialect, parser update, classification change, coverage rounding change or code-to-data displacement path.
